description: This file is a shell script used for generating a complex directory and file structure within a git repository for testing purposes. It creates nested directories and files, with configurable depth, width, and number of files per directory, and initializes a git repository with ballast data for performance testing.

methods.name: fill_index
methods.description: A function that populates the git index with empty files arranged in a nested directory structure based on provided parameters such as depth, width, and number of files.
